author: Allison

summary: GitHub CLI now supports GitHub Event Streams . With gh v2.105.0 , you and your agents can wait for a pull request to change with a single command instead of polling it in a loop.
takeaways: Agents discover the new commands on their own: gh pr create , gh pr view , gh run view , gh run watch , and gh api now suggest gh event listen instead of polling.
With gh v2.105.0 , you and your agents can wait for a pull request to change with a single command instead of polling it in a loop.
By default, it exits after the first event, so it slots into scripts and agent loops.
